description: Dumbbells, a pull-up bar and your bodyweight. Three full-body sessions a week with push-ups, rows and single-leg work. Hard sets taken close to failure grow muscle at home, too.

blockTypes.superset: Two exercises back to back, no rest between.

weeks.title: Settle in
weeks.focus: Stop each set about 3 reps before failure. Learn the lifts and find your starting weights.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest. Sit deep, elbows between your knees, drive up.

exercises.name: Pushups
exercises.instructions: Hands under shoulders, body in one line. Chest to the floor, elbows about 45° from your ribs.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hand on a bench. Row the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping your shoulders level.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Feet hip-width, ribs down. Press the dumbbells overhead and finish with biceps by your ears.

exercises.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: One foot planted, other leg extended. Drive up through your heel and squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Forearms down, body in one straight line. Squeeze glutes and abs. Stop when your hips sag.

exercises.name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Soft knees, push your hips back until your hamstrings stretch, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Push-Ups With Feet Elevated
exercises.instructions: Feet on a chair, body in one line. Lower your chest to the floor and press up.

exercises.name: Pullups
exercises.instructions: Start from a dead hang. Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down. Lower fully.

exercises.name: Side Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Slight lean forward. Lift your elbows out to shoulder height, pour the dumbbells like a jug.

exercises.name: Split Squat with Dumbbells
exercises.instructions: Long stance, drop your back knee straight down. Keep your torso upright and front heel planted.

blocks.name: Hammer Curls + Standing Dumbbell Triceps Extension

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
exercises.instructions: Palms face each other. Curl up without twisting your wrists.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower behind your head and press up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lunges
exercises.instructions: Step forward until your front thigh is parallel, back knee near the floor. Push back to standing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on the floor, lower until your upper arms touch down, pause, press. Easy on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward, flat back. Row both dumbbells to your hips, keeping elbows close.

exercises.name: Reverse Flyes
exercises.instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back. Raise your arms out wide with soft elbows. No swinging.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand on a step edge with a dumbbell. Heels drop below the step, then rise as high as you can.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: Lower back pressed into the floor. Extend opposite arm and leg slowly, then swap.

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.instructions: Lower back on the floor. Curl your ribs toward your hips and exhale at the top.

weeks.title: Add reps
weeks.focus: Beat last week's reps on your main lifts, stopping about 2 reps short of failure.

weeks.title: Deload
weeks.focus: Cut sets by about 40% and stay about 4 reps short of failure. Recovering now makes the next block better.
